reviews.title: Log in issues!
reviews.text: Can’t log in. Gonna listen to a different channel! Not sure why it’s so hard to listen to free radio! Not in the mood to mess about with it all today, sorry!

reviews.title: Great music always
reviews.text: How irritating that I had to sign in. Again. I listen every day so it’s not as if I’ve left it ages. I don’t have to sign in on Alexa. It says it improves the sound quality. It doesn’t. Music’s good though.

reviews.text:
This app has burned through 45.7gb of data in 5 days!!! What the hell is going on?
Same thing happened on the crate app too
